title: context-mode Plugin Install (PostToolUse Output Sandboxing)
reason: PostToolUse hooks intercept large tool outputs (Playwright snapshots 56KB→300B, grep dumps, curl responses) and route them to filesystem, injecting only compact summaries into the context window. Claims 98% per-tool token reduction. Directly relevant: persona testing pipeline uses Playwright heavily. Lossless — full data preserved on disk for retrieval. 7.3k GitHub stars. Elastic License 2.0.
risk_note: Plugin marketplace install modifies Claude Code plugin config. No env vars proposed. Hooks register automatically — no manual settings.json editing needed. All 5 hook types supported for Claude Code.
